name: ETL Amazon Marketing Cloud To BigQuery
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Amazon Marketing Cloud as the data source.
2.  Select your added BigQuery data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your Amazon account using the [+](https://api.datachannel.co/datasources/amazon-marketing-cloud/credentials/add?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiJ9.eyJpc3MiOiJzYW1wbGUtYXV0aC1zZXJ2ZXIiLCJzdWIiOiJjbGllbnRfMSIsInVpZCI6MTcxLCJzY29wZSI6ImZyb250ZW5kLWFwaSxyZXZlcnNlLWFwaSIsImV4cCI6MTY3MTA4Nzk0OS4zMTkxNzE0fQ.jih0bBGSqFz7SOy__RVheUiC57pizC1e4s2OSuCHvbVrPrPxUuvX_IwYLrYr2M9rMUxoj1DmPnwiKecgo_JKWyIugSH_x7NZoXMvyypfX2ybmz1CfZZmEkZGRykWqUcXCg78wC3ym8ombgzQi2xPhxiefIrAqAGJkT-YlQJ7xsauc5IT5pDH3HMhWGMYxbxmk3qyu8qYhdVBYbbXWdM7I1FFqJdpiRLetELoDZYgx7TYAxIo6RRd1pCnLfwNGSuz-ttKMZwrB0SMzsxZgon1zi1uOJxyewFO7gx9A63gNWHCTCRs9eqgtbtde5Qhg5js5-7qvLp6dJ7z49meiy5GCBMJX91w077t-GEOKmBLlDlX2F6m_5q5kEJKaERnekHYWM4Re8jJPZ6LzM0DVfnv7OKfWcEanJYs22amC55unWlWiQdDzK_wRSorQmMh7noRevFe0-ZBmaKqVp_1VoWo_9lVN10jCqnip0GCmI4dibflRDKYY4izq6E4LPvZRk0C) icon with your **Access Key, Secret Key, Base API URL** & **Region**.
